info.title: API.SH: Newegg
info.description: The Newegg API from API.SH: public Newegg data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products in a Newegg (US) category, about 36 per page, in any of the site's sort orders and with its filters: item number, name, brand, model, price, list price, rebate, shipping, stock, rating and review count, seller, images and bullet points, plus breadcrumbs (each with its `n` value), sub-categories and the filter facets (each value has a `filter_id` to pass back in `filters`). A store or category hub page without a product grid returns its `subcategories`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (at most 100 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/newegg-category

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A newegg.com SubCategory, Category or Store page, or a /p/pl?N= listing link.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: The category's filter value (`n` in breadcrumbs or sub-categories of a response, e.g. 100011693), instead of `url`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-100). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default featured).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filter ids (`filter_id` from the facets of a previous response), comma separated.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in USD.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in USD.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products for a search on Newegg (US): item number, name, brand, model, price, list price, rebate, shipping, stock, rating and review count, seller, category, images and bullet points, about 36 per page, plus the filter facets (each value has a `filter_id` to pass back in `filters`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page (Newegg shows at most 100 pages). Broad one-word queries (keyboard, mouse, tv) that Newegg sends to a category hub are searched inside the best-matching category of that hub; `category_redirect` then names it.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/newegg-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-100). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Comma-separated `filter_id` values from the `facets` of a previous response (brand, category, sold by, specs).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Newegg marketplace seller: id, store key and name, link, about text, rating, review count and positive share (all time and the last 12 months), followers, top-rated flag, status, address, return policy and the store's categories; plus its items, 36 a page, with the same fields as search. Find a seller by its store name (newegg.com/Seller-Store/<name>) or by one of its items. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/newegg-seller

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Store name as in newegg.com/Seller-Store/<name> (or that link in `url`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A newegg.com/Seller-Store/<name> link.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: An item number the seller sells (e.g. 9SIC0X3KG23952), to find the seller.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of items.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the items.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
